dashboard.name: Cityborn dev — Activité de l'API
dashboard.description: Appels reçus par le backend en dev (requêtes HTTP et messages WebSocket), hors préflights CORS.

query.apl:
['cityborn-backend-dev']
| where event in ("http_request", "ws_message") and not(route == "<unmatched>")
| summarize calls=count()

['cityborn-backend-dev']
| where event in ("http_request", "ws_message") and not(route == "<unmatched>")
| summarize clientErrorRate=100.0 * countif(outcome == "client_error") / count()

['cityborn-backend-dev']
| where event in ("http_request", "ws_message") and not(route == "<unmatched>")
| summarize serverErrorRate=100.0 * countif(outcome == "server_error") / count()

['cityborn-backend-dev']
| where event in ("http_request", "ws_message") and not(route == "<unmatched>")
| summarize p95=percentile(durationMs, 95)

['cityborn-backend-dev']
| where event in ("http_request", "ws_message") and not(route == "<unmatched>")
| summarize count() by bin_auto(_time), action

['cityborn-backend-dev']
| where event in ("http_request", "ws_message") and not(route == "<unmatched>")
| summarize count() by bin_auto(_time), outcome

['cityborn-backend-dev']
| where event in ("http_request", "ws_message") and not(route == "<unmatched>")
| summarize percentiles_array(durationMs, 50, 95, 99) by bin_auto(_time)

['cityborn-backend-dev']
| where event in ("http_request", "ws_message") and not(route == "<unmatched>")
| summarize calls=count(), clientErrors=countif(outcome == "client_error"), serverErrors=countif(outcome == "server_error"), p95Ms=percentile(durationMs, 95) by transport, action
| top 20 by calls

['cityborn-backend-dev']
| where isnotnull(event) and not(route == "<unmatched>")
| project _time, event, action, outcome, statusCode, durationMs, errorCode, client, requestId
| order by _time desc
| take 100
